name: 8BitDo controllers and adapters
summary: 8BitDo game controllers, arcade sticks and wireless adapters. Most of them can pretend to be different controllers, and which mode they start in decides what works.

linux.notes: In Xbox (X-input) mode they use Linux's built-in xpad driver; in other modes the generic HID driver. Steam supports them too. If buttons are mixed up, try the other mode.

win32.notes: Xbox (X-input) mode works best on Windows because most games expect an Xbox controller. 8BitDo's Ultimate Software can update the firmware.

darwin.notes: Many 8BitDo controllers have a mode for Apple devices; check your model's manual for the button to hold while switching it on. In Xbox (X-input) mode over a cable, macOS may not see it.
